CustomField.description: In Business Days Completed approvals: Timestamp RVP/Fed VP - Date Created Rejection: Date Rejected - Date Created In progress: Now - Lead Owner Changed Timestamp Not started: Now - Created Date
CustomField.formula:
CASE ( TEXT( or_Opp_Reg_Approval_Flow_Status__c ), "Approvals complete", ((5 * ( FLOOR( ( DATEVALUE(or_New_Opp_Reg_Time_RVP_FED_VP_Completed__c ) - DATE( 1900, 1, 8) ) / 7 ) ) + MIN( 5, MOD( DATEVALUE(or_New_Opp_Reg_Time_RVP_FED_VP_Completed__c ) - DATE( 1900, 1, 8), 7 ) ) ) - (5 * ( FLOOR( ( DATEVALUE(OR_Created_Date_n_Time__c) - DATE( 1900, 1, 8) ) / 7 ) ) + MIN( 5, MOD( DATEVALUE(OR_Created_Date_n_Time__c) - DATE( 1900, 1, 8), 7 ) ) )),
"Approver rejected", ((5 * ( FLOOR( ( Date_Rejected__c - DATE( 1900, 1, 8) ) / 7 ) ) + MIN( 5, MOD( Date_Rejected__c - DATE( 1900, 1, 8), 7 ) ) ) - (5 * ( FLOOR( ( DATEVALUE(OR_Created_Date_n_Time__c) - DATE( 1900, 1, 8) ) / 7 ) ) + MIN( 5, MOD( DATEVALUE(OR_Created_Date_n_Time__c) - DATE( 1900, 1, 8), 7 ) ) )),
"Approvals not started", ((5 * ( FLOOR( ( today() - DATE( 1900, 1, 8) ) / 7 ) ) + MIN( 5, MOD( today() - DATE( 1900, 1, 8), 7 ) ) ) - (5 * ( FLOOR( ( DATEVALUE(OR_Created_Date_n_Time__c) - DATE( 1900, 1, 8) ) / 7 ) ) + MIN( 5, MOD( DATEVALUE(OR_Created_Date_n_Time__c) - DATE( 1900, 1, 8), 7 ) ) )),
"Approvals in progress", ((5 * ( FLOOR( ( today() - DATE( 1900, 1, 8) ) / 7 ) ) + MIN( 5, MOD( today() - DATE( 1900, 1, 8), 7 ) ) ) - (5 * ( FLOOR( ( DATEVALUE(OR_Created_Date_n_Time__c) - DATE( 1900, 1, 8) ) / 7 ) ) + MIN( 5, MOD( DATEVALUE(OR_Created_Date_n_Time__c) - DATE( 1900, 1, 8), 7 ) ) )),
0)
